_note: Hazard levels from the design; find odds are PLACEHOLDERS (M7a: each terrain has its own table, every one with a mystery share for the planetfall cards). Each finds array sums to 100 and lines up with findKinds. flavour is one short line shown on the region card.

terrains.name: Plains
terrains.flavour: Open grass and slow rivers. Easy marching, little cover.

terrains.name: Highlands
terrains.flavour: Broken ridges and thin soil. Ore in the cuts, good ground for a wall.

terrains.name: Jungle
terrains.flavour: Wet, dense and loud. Food everywhere, and fever with it.

terrains.name: Ice
terrains.flavour: Wind and white glare. Clean water and fuel in the ice, little else.

terrains.name: Crater
terrains.flavour: A scarred bowl of fused rock. Rare minerals and few safe paths.

terrains.name: Ruins
terrains.flavour: Fallen stone older than any record. Strange machines, and traps.
